Company

Established in 1983, Amit Engineering Works is the only tamping machine spare parts manufacturer in India — a leading exporter, wholesaler, and supplier of spares and assemblies to Indian Railways.

With over 40 years of experience and the 720° Crystal Model approach, we deliver top-notch client satisfaction, innovative solutions, and unmatched sales support.

Overview

ISO 9001 certified since establishment. We provide every micro-assistance for tamping machine spare parts, aiming to be the universal choice for railways worldwide.

Mission

To provide the highest-quality end products through dedication, innovation, and integrity — adhering to environmental regulations and supporting growth of our people.

Vision

To be the best service provider delivering innovative, cost-effective solutions that meet international standards and help all stakeholders grow through quality and satisfying service.

Machines We Serve
Tamping Machine

09-3X Dynamic Tamping Express

Plasser American 3-sleeper tamping. We supply TCTT PM-216 to PM-220 series, squeezing cylinders, and tamping bank components.

Tamping Machine

Duomatic 09-32 CSM

Plasser & Theurer 2-sleeper tamping machine. Full TCTT range supported: PM-211 to PM-215 series for old type CSM machines.

Ballast Cleaning

RM 80 Ballast Cleaning Machine

Excavating depth up to 1150 mm. We supply complete excavating chain assemblies — with and without carbide chisels — for Indian Railway BCM RM 80.

Ballast Cleaning

RM 900 HD-100

High-performance ballast excavation machine. Our excavating chains with tungsten carbide fingers meet all demanding requirements.

Switch Tamping

UNIMAT 2S / 3S / 4S

Switch and crossing tamping. Dedicated TCTT: PM-221-J for 2S/3S & 4S, PM-222-K for 4S Unimate, PM-223-L for 2S/3S Unimate.

Tamping Machine

Plasser & Theurer Series

Full range for 08/32U, 08/32, 07/16, 09-Dynamic, Duomatic, and new MFI machines. TCTT PM-228 and PM-118 (New MFI) also available.

Products

Tungsten Carbide Tamping Tool (TCTT)

High-strength alloy tamping tools with full tungsten carbide coverage. CNC-produced, RDSO compliant. Available for CSM, 3X/DTE, Plasser, UNIMAT machines.

TCTT — In Action on Track

Our tungsten carbide tamping tools operating on Indian Railway tracks. Designed for easy penetration into ballast and strong enough to compact sleeper beds.

Squeezing Cylinders for Plasser Tamping Machine

Forge 1-piece steel grade A or B for DUO/CSM tamping units. Operates at 35 Hz vibration under 150 kg/sq.cm hydraulic pressure.

Cutting Chain — Plasser Ballast Cleaning Machine

Scraper shovels with 2–5 tungsten carbide fingers. Available for BCM RM 800, RM 74/76, RM 80, HOBCM — with or without carbide chisels.

Tungsten Carbide Tamping Tool — Specifications

  • Manufactured from Chromium Molybdenum / Nickel Chromium Molybdenum alloy steel
  • Withstands minimum vibration frequency of 35 Hz and squeeze pressure of 120 kg/sq.cm
  • CNC-produced matching fitting surfaces; full tungsten carbide coverage on pad and wear areas
  • Slim, insertion-friendly profile meeting RDSO specification; easily removable from tamping arm
  • Saves minimum 30% cost vs ordinary tools; increases tool life up to 15×
  • Reduces transportation time and manpower by up to 20×
  • Compatible with: 09/32 CSM, 09/16 CSM, 08/32U, 08/32, 07/16, 09-Dynamic, Duomatic, Unimate 3S & 4S, New MFI machine

TCTT Benefits vs Ordinary Tamping Tools

  • Less inventory required — fewer tool variants needed across machine types
  • Improves the quality of tamping and the life of the tamping bank
  • Reduces down time of costly machines
  • Increases insertion count, performance, productivity & durability
  • Increases life up to 15 times compared to standard tamping tools

Squeezing Cylinders — Specifications

  • Conforms to IS: 2062-1992; minimum tensile strength 410 MPa; elongation ≥ 23%
  • Golden yellow synthetic enamel paint (two coats); boiled linseed oil on functional surface
  • Oil holes protected with plastic caps; manufacturer code engraved on each cylinder
  • 09-CSM: 50% higher work capacity, non-synchronous uniform pressure tamping, 35 Hz frequency
  • 09-3X: 30–40% output increase; flexible single or three-sleeper tamping

Cutting Chain Assemblies — Specifications

  • Complete sets of 69 to 105 Nos. depending on machine type
  • Available for: BCM RM 800, RM 74/76, RM 80, HOBCM RM 80, FRM 80 SBCM, Russian BCM 1400, GMEC QSM-400
  • Options: with carbide chisels, without carbide chisels, high-output versions
  • Excavating depth: up to 900 mm (RM 76 U) and 1150 mm (RM 80 U)
